title: 亚马逊 CEO 怎样说明已公布与未定的岗位调整（2022）
topic: 亚马逊 CEO 怎样说明已公布与未定的岗位调整（2022）

source.title: A note from CEO Andy Jassy about role eliminations
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 基于 Amazon CEO 2022 年员工邮件；邮件分别说明已公布的岗位调整、已知将继续调整的组织、尚未确定的具体人数及沟通顺序。
paragraphs: The message below was shared with Amazon employees today.

Two weeks ago, Beth shared that S-team and I decided to pause new incremental hires in our corporate workforce. Today, I want to share some information about role eliminations. We are in the middle of our annual operating planning review where we look at each of our businesses and make decisions about what we believe we should change. Leaders across the company are working with their teams and looking at their workforce levels, investments they want to make in the future, and prioritizing what matters most to customers and the long-term health of our businesses. This year’s review is more difficult due to the fact that the economy remains in a challenging spot and we’ve hired rapidly the last several years.

Yesterday, we communicated the difficult decision to eliminate a number of positions across our Devices and Books businesses, and also announced a voluntary reduction offer for some employees in our People, Experience, and Technology (PXT) organization. Our annual planning process extends into the new year, which means there will be more role reductions as leaders continue to make adjustments. Those decisions will be shared with impacted employees and organizations early in 2023. We haven’t concluded yet exactly how many other roles will be impacted (we know that there will be reductions in our Stores and PXT organizations), but each leader will communicate to their respective teams when we have the details nailed down. And, as has been the case this week, we will prioritize communicating directly with impacted employees before making broad public or internal announcements.
translations: 以下信息今日已与亚马逊员工分享。
两周前，Beth 告诉大家，S 团队和我决定暂停公司职能部门的新增岗位招聘。今天，我想介绍一些岗位缩减的情况。我们正在进行年度运营规划，审视各项业务并决定需要作出哪些调整。公司各地的领导者正与团队一起评估人员规模、未来投资方向，并确定哪些事项最有利于顾客和业务的长期发展。今年的评估格外艰难，因为经济形势仍然严峻，而且过去几年我们的招聘规模增长很快。

昨日，我们做出了艰难的决定，将在设备和图书业务部门裁减多个职位，同时宣布面向人力、体验和技术（PXT）组织部分员工提供自愿离职补偿方案。我们的年度规划流程将持续到新的一年，这意味着随着领导者继续进行调整，还将有更多的职位裁减。这些决策将在2023年初与受影响的员工和组织进行沟通。我们尚未最终确定还会有多少其他职位受到影响（我们知道商店和PXT组织将会有裁员），但每位领导者在细节敲定后，都会向各自团队进行沟通。此外，正如本周的情况一样，我们将在进行广泛的公开或内部公告之前，优先与受影响的员工进行直接沟通。
fullTextParagraphs: The message below was shared with Amazon employees today.

Two weeks ago, Beth shared that S-team and I decided to pause new incremental hires in our corporate workforce. Today, I want to share some information about role eliminations. We are in the middle of our annual operating planning review where we look at each of our businesses and make decisions about what we believe we should change. Leaders across the company are working with their teams and looking at their workforce levels, investments they want to make in the future, and prioritizing what matters most to customers and the long-term health of our businesses. This year’s review is more difficult due to the fact that the economy remains in a challenging spot and we’ve hired rapidly the last several years.

Yesterday, we communicated the difficult decision to eliminate a number of positions across our Devices and Books businesses, and also announced a voluntary reduction offer for some employees in our People, Experience, and Technology (PXT) organization. Our annual planning process extends into the new year, which means there will be more role reductions as leaders continue to make adjustments. Those decisions will be shared with impacted employees and organizations early in 2023. We haven’t concluded yet exactly how many other roles will be impacted (we know that there will be reductions in our Stores and PXT organizations), but each leader will communicate to their respective teams when we have the details nailed down. And, as has been the case this week, we will prioritize communicating directly with impacted employees before making broad public or internal announcements.

I’ve been in this role now for about a year and a half, and without a doubt, this is the most difficult decision we’ve made during that time (and, we’ve had to make some very tough calls over the past couple of years, particularly during the heart of the pandemic). It’s not lost on me or any of the leaders who make these decisions that these aren’t just roles we’re eliminating, but rather, people with emotions, ambitions, and responsibilities whose lives will be impacted. We are working to support those who are affected and trying to help them find new roles on teams that have a need; and in cases where that’s not possible, we are offering packages that include a separation payment, transitional health insurance benefits, and external job placement support.

Amazon has weathered uncertainty and difficult economies in the past, and we will continue to do so. We have big opportunities ahead, both in our more established businesses like Stores, Advertising, and AWS, but also in our newer initiatives that we’ve been working on for a number of years and have conviction in pursuing (e.g. Prime Video, Alexa, Kuiper, Zoox, and Healthcare). The key will be to do what Amazon does best – obsess over customers and invent relentlessly on their behalf – and if we do that, we should all be very optimistic about Amazon’s future. I know I am.
I want to thank each of you for your continuing contributions during this challenging time and as we gear up to deliver for customers during the busy shopping season.

notes.phrase: The message below was shared with Amazon employees today
notes.meaning: 以下信息今日已与 Amazon 员工分享
notes.explain: 这是原信页面的导语，不是岗位调整的决策内容。
notes.example: The updated schedule was shared with all department heads yesterday.

notes.explain: incremental 在这里修饰 hires，指新增招聘；句子说的是公司职能部门招聘安排。
notes.example: We will pause incremental hiring while the budget is reviewed.

notes.explain: 原文指取消岗位。不要单凭这个词推断某位员工的离职条款；邮件后文另行说明对受影响员工的支持。
notes.example: The update described role eliminations in two business units.

notes.explain: 邮件说该方案面向 PXT 组织的部分员工；它与已宣布的岗位裁减是不同的信息。
notes.example: Some employees were offered a voluntary separation option.

notes.phrase: we haven’t concluded yet exactly how many other roles will be impacted
notes.meaning: 其他受影响岗位的具体数量尚未确定
notes.explain: 括号同时说明 Stores 和 PXT 会有岗位缩减；未确定的是其他岗位受影响的准确数量。
notes.example: We have not finalized how many additional roles will be affected.

notes.phrase: communicating directly with impacted employees before making broad public or internal announcements
notes.meaning: 先直接告知受影响员工，再作范围更广的公告
notes.explain: prioritize 在此表示安排沟通先后，不代表公开公告永远不会发布。
notes.example: We will contact the affected teams before sending a company-wide update.

scenario.title: Separate announced changes from details still pending
english: A teammate asks what Amazon’s 2022 message had confirmed about role reductions and what was still unknown.

The message announced position eliminations in Devices and Books and a voluntary reduction offer for some PXT employees. It also said further reductions were expected in Stores and PXT, while the exact number of other affected roles was not yet known.
You summarize the confirmed details, state what remained undecided, and explain when and how leaders would communicate more.
chinese: 一位同事想知道，Amazon 2022 年的邮件确认了哪些岗位调整，还有哪些信息未知。
邮件宣布 Devices 和 Books 业务会裁减岗位，并向部分 PXT 员工提供自愿离职方案。邮件还说 Stores 和 PXT 将继续调整，但其他受影响岗位的具体数量当时尚未确定。
你概括已确认的信息、指出仍未确定的部分，并说明领导者何时、按什么顺序继续沟通。

firstAttempt.prompt: 同事请你概括 Amazon 2022 年邮件中已宣布的调整、已知还会调整的组织、当时尚未确定的内容，以及后续沟通安排。请用两到三句英文回答。
firstAttempt.sample: The message announced position eliminations in Devices and Books and a voluntary reduction offer for some PXT employees. Further reductions were expected in Stores and PXT, but the exact number of other affected roles had not been finalized; leaders would share details with affected employees early in 2023, before broader announcements.
firstAttempt.rationale: 把已经公布的事项、已知将继续调整的组织和未定人数分开，再准确说明时间与沟通顺序。

words.example: The message referred to pausing new incremental hires in the corporate workforce.
words.translation: 邮件提到暂停公司职能部门的新增招聘。
words.note: 这里的 incremental 修饰 hires，表示新增招聘；不要把它理解为逐步减少员工。

words.example: Leaders were reviewing workforce levels across their businesses.
words.translation: 各业务领导者正在评估员工规模。
words.note: 在组织语境中指员工队伍或员工规模；具体人数需有原文依据。

words.meaning: 优先考虑；确定优先顺序
words.example: The message said leaders would prioritize direct communication with affected employees.
words.translation: 邮件表示，领导者会优先直接联系受影响员工。
words.note: 常用结构是 prioritize + 名词；此处说明沟通顺序。

words.example: The CEO described the economic situation as challenging.
words.translation: CEO 将当时的经济形势描述为严峻。
words.note: 原文说经济形势严峻，不等于每个业务都面临同样的具体问题。

words.example: The message said there would be more role reductions as planning continued.
words.translation: 邮件表示，随着规划继续，还会有更多岗位缩减。
words.note: role reduction 指岗位缩减；不能据此推断未公布的具体人数。

words.collocation: nail down the details / a date
words.example: Each leader would share details once they had nailed them down.
words.translation: 各位领导者会在细节敲定后进行沟通。
words.note: 原文用 details nailed down，表示细节已确定；常见主动表达为 nail down the details。

structure.original: We haven’t concluded yet exactly how many other roles will be impacted (we know that there will be reductions in our Stores and PXT organizations), but each leader will communicate to their respective teams when we have the details nailed down.
analysis: 主句 We haven’t concluded yet 表示“截至当时还没有确定”；yet 与现在完成时的否定形式配合。
括号内 we know that there will be reductions in our Stores and PXT organizations 补充已知信息；but 转回到未确定的具体人数。
when we have the details nailed down 是时间从句，说明各位领导者会在细节敲定后向各自团队沟通。
structure.transfer: We haven’t finalized exactly how many support shifts will be added next month.

rewrite.bad: Amazon had already finalized the exact number of all future role reductions and planned to announce everything publicly first.
rewrite.good: The message said further reductions were expected in Stores and PXT, but the exact number of other affected roles had not been finalized. Leaders would communicate directly with affected employees before broader announcements.
rewrite.translation: 邮件表示 Stores 和 PXT 还会有岗位缩减，但其他受影响岗位的具体数量尚未确定。领导者会先直接联系受影响员工，再作范围更广的公告。
rewrite.pattern: The message confirmed [known changes], while [the detail still pending] had not been finalized. Leaders would [next step] before [broader communication].

cloze.prompt: The message announced position ___ in Devices and Books.
cloze.why: 用原文的 position eliminations 概括已经宣布的岗位裁减。

cloze.prompt: The exact number of other affected roles had not been ___.
cloze.why: had not been finalized 表明当时具体数量尚未确定。

cloze.prompt: Leaders would communicate directly with affected employees before broader ___.
cloze.why: before 连接先后顺序；先联系受影响员工，再作更广泛公告。

dictation.text: We haven’t concluded yet exactly how many other roles will be impacted (we know that there will be reductions in our Stores and PXT organizations), but each leader will communicate to their respective teams when we have the details nailed down.
dictation.label: 听写 1 · 已知部门与未定人数
dictation.why: 这是邮件原句；注意括号里的 Stores 和 PXT 已知会有缩减，而具体影响人数尚未敲定。

dictation.text: And, as has been the case this week, we will prioritize communicating directly with impacted employees before making broad public or internal announcements.
dictation.label: 听写 2 · 沟通顺序
dictation.why: 这是邮件原句，明确先直接沟通，再作更广泛的公开或内部公告。

apply.prompt: 同事说公司会先发全员公告，再通知受影响员工。用一句英文纠正顺序。
apply.sample: The message says leaders will communicate directly with affected employees before making broader announcements.

translationPractice.prompt: 邮件宣布 Devices 和 Books 业务会裁减岗位。
translationPractice.answer: The message announced position eliminations in Devices and Books.
translationPractice.why: position eliminations 对应“岗位裁减”；Devices 和 Books 是邮件明确提到的业务。

translationPractice.prompt: 其他受影响岗位的具体数量当时尚未确定。
translationPractice.answer: The exact number of other affected roles had not been finalized.
translationPractice.why: 保留原信中 other roles 和 exact number 的范围，没有推测数字。

translationPractice.prompt: 领导者会先直接联系受影响员工，再作范围更广的公告。
translationPractice.answer: Leaders would communicate directly with affected employees before broader announcements.
translationPractice.why: before 明确两步的先后顺序。

choice.prompt: 哪一项准确概括了邮件对后续岗位调整的说明？
options: Reductions were expected in Stores and PXT, but the exact number of other affected roles had not been finalized.
The exact number of every future role reduction was already final, and all affected employees had been contacted.
No further role reductions were expected after the Devices and Books decisions.
choice.why: 原文明确说 Stores 和 PXT 会有岗位缩减，但其他受影响岗位的准确数量尚未确定。

output.prompt: （模拟情景）一家虚构公司的 Billing 组已确认裁减两个岗位，Support 组是否还会调整、涉及多少岗位仍在评估。一位同事以为所有人数都已确定。请用两句英文区分已确认与未定信息，并说明细节确定后的沟通顺序。
output.sample: Two Billing role eliminations have been confirmed, while the number of any additional Support changes has not been finalized. We will contact affected employees directly once the details are confirmed, before sending a broader update.
check: 是否只把 Billing 的两个岗位写成已确认？
是否清楚说明 Support 的调整和数量仍未定？
是否说明先直接联系受影响员工，再发送更广泛更新？
